answer: The island test I would run is Warranted IT auditor registration with IT auditors attestation: a registration auditors renew after system audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the lagoon of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out. The horizon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
